title: A new photo shows in the Staff list after a reload
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Needs: 2 users · 2 browsers · about 15 minutes
  • Build: the Work Orders QA build (sv10043, v26.40.8-7a95011), desktop browser, window at least 1024 px wide.
  • Role: Owner/Admin. On the sign-in page click the Admin quick-login button (you appear as Admin ShopView). The Admin role has Work orders > View and Create & Edit (check: your initials (top right) > Settings > Roles & Permissions > Admin > edit).
  • Location: Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 for the whole case (shown next to the bell; change it with your initials > Change Location).
  • Two clearly different photos on your computer (e.g. a red square and a blue square).
  • One technician [Tech-A] at this location (Role Technician, Departments = Service, Time Clock on) who can sign in with her own email and password. Name is an example ("Esther Howard").

Setup

  1. Your initials (top right) > Settings > Staff > New Staff Member: First Name, Last Name, Email > Role = Technician > Departments = Service (only technicians in the Service department show as rows on the Schedule) > Location = Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 > turn Time Clock on > Save & Close. Record the technician as [Tech-A] (the expected results call this technician "Esther Howard"). Give her an email you can open; she accepts the invitation and sets a password.
  2. As [Tech-A], upload the red photo (the person signs in, clicks their initials at the top right > Edit Profile, clicks "Click to upload a profile photo" and picks the file; the picture shows at once).
  3. Check the setup worked: as [Tech-A], the top bar shows the red photo.
custom_steps:
1. Click Settings (your initials > Settings), then Staff, and look at [Tech-A]'s avatar.
  2. Upload the blue photo as [Tech-A]'s photo (the person signs in, clicks their initials at the top right > Edit Profile, clicks "Click to upload a profile photo" and picks the file; the picture shows at once).
  3. Go back to the same place and reload the page.
  4. Look at the avatar again.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Before the upload the avatar shows the red photo.
  • After the reload it shows the blue photo, not the old red one.

What you should see today (build v26.40.8-7a95011, 10/8/2026): The Staff list shows no photos at all: the row has First Name, Last Name, Email, Job Title, Role, Department(S), Created, Confirmed Invitation and Billable, with no avatar, before or after the upload. (1) If you see exactly that, mark the case Failed and raise nothing new. (2) If it fails in a different way, that is a new problem: report it. (3) If it behaves as the expected results above say, the change has shipped: mark it Passed and tell the QA lead.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Regression for epic SV-10043 (PR #3548); developer's regression list, received 8 Oct 2026, Medium 9; QA handoff test plan (generated 2026-10-08), §9, hotspot 5; PRD Confluence 845185030 (edited 7 Oct 2026) where quoted. Source-verified 8 October 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • Dev reply 9: “Avatars everywhere (header, Staff, Schedule, cards). Avatars are now cached. After someone uploads a new photo, a reload must show the new one.”
  • QA handoff §9: “After a new photo is uploaded, a reload shows the new image.”

Last checked against build v26.40.8-7a95011 on 10/8/2026.
